steps.summary: Signed in as admin on http://127.0.0.1:8085/ and navigated via Project management → "Bench Board" to its board view (BoardViewController, project_id=1). The board's column headers, read left-to-right from the live DOM, are: Backlog , Ready , Work in progress , Done .

Created the task from the 'Bench Board' board view via the Backlog column's "Add a new task" form, filled Title 'fwkb30-n3 Bench Task' and Description 'Task created for run fwkb30-n3', and clicked Save. The app assigned task ID 4 (task page heading "Task #4"), and the task landed in the default first column, Backlog. The task detail page (/?controller=TaskViewController&action=show&task_id=4) shows the title exactly as 'fwkb30-n3 Bench Task' and Description 'Task created for run fwkb30-n3', with Column: Backlog, Status: open.
